blocks.text: Mark 8 contains 38 verses. It opens with: In those days, when there was again a great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, It concludes with: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of man also shall be ashamed of him, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
